## What's Changed

- Added an optional real-IP Ping bypass switch under Settings. Ordinary IPv4 and IPv6 Ping traffic can use the system route while device policies retain priority.
- Excluded default, configured, and previously active FakeIP pools from the Ping bypass rule.
- Required the core to be stopped before changing Ping bypass, with configuration validation and settings rollback on failure.
- Shortened descriptions in the general settings panel.
- Fixed switch state recovery when an update response is lost. The UI reads the saved state back and shows an unconfirmed state until synchronization succeeds.
- Fixed SSH MCP execution timeouts: connection, proxy negotiation, SSH handshake, session creation, and command execution now share the requested timeout instead of failing at a fixed 10-second connection limit. Timeout messages identify the failing stage.

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/ackwrap/ackrun/compare/v1.0.5...v1.0.6
